seo.title: Street Food in Belgrade (2026) | tabiji.ai
seo.metaDescription: Discover the best street food in Belgrade for 2026 — curated picks with maps, hours, and insider tips.

hero.h1: 12 Best Street Food in Belgrade (2026) — Reddit-Backed Guide
hero.subtitle: The definitive guide to Belgrade's legendary street food scene — pljeskavica, ćevapi, burek & more, curated from Reddit reviews and local recommendations.

picks.name: 1Ćevap kod Dekija
picks.whatToOrder: The ćevapi sa kajmakom (10 pieces with kajmak) — perfectly charred minced meat cylinders with lepinja and impossibly creamy kajmak.
picks.mapQuery: Ćevap kod Dekija, Dobračina 42, Belgrade, RS

picks.name: 2Loki
picks.whatToOrder: The gurmanska pljeskavica — a massive grilled patty stuffed with kajmak and cheese in lepinja. Get it with ajvar and urnebes.

picks.name: 3Pekara Trpković
picks.whatToOrder: The burek sa mesom (meat) — impossibly flaky phyllo with seasoned minced meat. Always pair with cold jogurt.

picks.name: 4Walter
picks.whatToOrder: The Sarajevski ćevapi — 10 pieces in traditional somun bread with raw onions and kajmak.

picks.name: 5Burek Non-Stop Čubura
picks.whatToOrder: Their burek sa sirom (cheese) is genuinely excellent at any hour. Fresh batches come out all night.
picks.mapQuery: Burek Non-Stop Čubura, Cara Nikolaja Drugog 3, Vračar, RS

picks.name: 6Prava Pljeskavica
picks.whatToOrder: The klasična pljeskavica with kajmak, ajvar, and raw onions. Simply seasoned and grilled to perfection.

picks.name: 7Drama Ćevapi
picks.whatToOrder: Their kobasice (grilled sausages) are the star — served with incredible bread and all the sauces.

picks.name: 8Zeleni Venac Market
picks.whatToOrder: Head to the pekara in the southwest corner for spectacular burek. Browse for ajvar, kajmak, and local cheeses.
picks.mapQuery: Zeleni Venac Market, Jug Bogdanova, Belgrade, RS

picks.name: 9Roštilj The Leskovac
picks.whatToOrder: The leskovačka pljeskavica — the legally-protected Leskovac-style patty. Thicker and more seasoned.
picks.mapQuery: Roštilj The Leskovac, Milovana Milovanovića, Belgrade, RS

picks.name: 10Lili M-Burek
picks.whatToOrder: Their burek sa mesom is the standout. The burek sa krompirom (potato) is a sleeper hit.
picks.mapQuery: Lili M-Burek, Jug Bogdanova 26, Belgrade, RS

picks.name: 11Crna Ovca
picks.whatToOrder: The sesame ice cream with chocolate espresso beans — their signature. Also try baklava or lavender.
picks.mapQuery: Crna Ovca, Kralja Petra 58, Belgrade, RS

picks.name: 12Kafana Pavle Korcagin
picks.whatToOrder: The mešano meso (mixed grill) — pljeskavica, ćevapi, kobasice, and ražnjići. The karađorđeva šnicla is a must-try.
picks.mapQuery: Kafana Pavle Korcagin, Ćirila i Metodija 2a, Belgrade, RS
